items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Which letter comes right after B in the alphabet?
items.explain: The alphabet goes A, B, C, so C comes right after B.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Listen to the word 'sun'. Which word starts with the same sound as 'sun'?
items.explain: Sun and sock both begin with the /s/ sound.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Which word rhymes with 'cat'?
items.explain: Cat and hat share the same ending sound -at.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Listen to the word 'bed'. Which word ends with the same sound as 'bed'?
items.explain: Bed and lid both end with the /d/ sound.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Listen to these sounds: /p/ /i/ /g/. Put them together. What word do they make?
items.explain: /p/ + /i/ + /g/ blends to make 'pig'.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Clap the parts of the word 'rabbit': rab-bit. How many claps (syllables) do you hear?
items.explain: Rab-bit has two syllables.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: When we read a page in an English book, where do we start reading?
options: At the bottom of the page
At the top left of the page
In the middle of the page
items.explain: English is read from the top left, moving left to right.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Point to the word 'and'. (Show the child the three printed words.)
items.explain: The printed word a-n-d spells 'and'.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Listen. 'Ben has a red ball. He gives the ball to his little sister, Joy.' Who gets the ball?
items.explain: Ben gives the ball to Joy, so Joy gets it.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Which one is a fruit?
items.explain: An apple is a fruit; a chair and a shoe are not food.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which letter is missing? d, e, __, g
items.explain: Alphabetical order is d, e, f, g.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Read and understand a simple sentence
items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'Pam has a pet pup.' What does Pam have?
items.explain: The sentence says Pam has a pet pup.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Distinguish long a from short a
items.prompt: Which word has the long a sound, as in 'cake'?
items.explain: In 'rain' the letters ai make the long a sound; the others have short a.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Find short i in a sentence
items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'Mike will ride his bike to the lake.' Which word has the short i sound?
items.explain: 'Will' has a short i; Mike, ride and bike have a long i.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word begins with the 'ch' sound and has a short e sound?
items.explain: 'Chest' begins with ch and has a short e; cheek has long e, shell begins with sh, chain has long a.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: In which word does the letter c make the /s/ sound?
items.explain: In 'face' the c is followed by e, so it makes the soft /s/ sound.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: Right now, Sam is ___ a picture for Grandma.
items.explain: 'Is' with 'right now' needs the -ing form: is painting.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: In which word does the letter y make the long i sound?
items.explain: At the end of 'fly', y says long i; in the others y says /y/.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word has the same vowel sound as 'moon'?
items.explain: 'Spoon' has the long oo sound like moon; book has short oo.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word has the long o sound, as in 'boat'?
items.explain: In 'road' the oa team makes the long o sound; the others have short o.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word has the same vowel sound as 'book'?
items.explain: 'Wood' and 'book' share the short oo sound.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word has the same vowel sound as 'cow'?
items.explain: The ou in 'house' sounds like the ow in 'cow'; snow, show and grow have long o.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: How many vowels are in the word 'garden'?
items.explain: G-a-r-d-e-n has two vowels: a and e.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence needs a question mark at the end?
items.explain: 'Where is my blue coat' asks something, so it needs a question mark.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: The children ___ singing in church last Sunday.
items.explain: 'Children' is plural and the time is past, so 'were' is correct.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the word that completes the sentence: Grandpa ate ___ orange after lunch.
items.explain: 'Orange' begins with a vowel sound, so we use 'an'.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Identify a noun in a sentence
items.prompt: Which word in this sentence is a noun? 'We walked quickly to the old bridge.'
items.explain: 'Bridge' names a thing, so it is a noun.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word in this sentence is a proper noun? 'My best friend Lucy lives near the river.'
items.explain: 'Lucy' names a specific person, so it is a proper noun.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word is an action word (verb)? 'The little puppy jumped over the fence.'
items.explain: 'Jumped' tells what the puppy did.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Read: 'Hannah was glad when her grandmother came to visit. She hugged her and smiled all day.' Which word means almost the same as 'glad'?
items.explain: 'Glad' and 'happy' are synonyms; the hugging and smiling show it.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: ___ your sister like to read?
items.explain: 'Sister' is singular, so the question begins with 'Does'.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: Last night the wind ___ the leaves off the tree.
items.explain: 'Blew' is the past tense of blow; 'blue' is a color.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence is written correctly?
options: The dogs bone is under the porch.
The dog's bone is under the porch.
The dogs' bone are under the porch.
The dog bone's is under the porch.
items.explain: One dog owns the bone, so we write dog's, and 'bone is' agrees.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which list of words is in alphabetical order?
items.explain: a, b, c, d is alphabetical: ant, bell, cup, dog.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word comes FIRST in alphabetical order?
items.explain: All begin with br; the third letters are e, i, a, o, and a comes first. (Cursive handwriting cannot be assessed in text, so alphabetizing is measured instead.)

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which group of words is a complete sentence?
items.explain: 'Joel shared his lunch.' has a subject and a verb and a complete thought.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: What is the subject of this sentence? 'Every morning, the farmer feeds his cows.'
items.explain: The farmer is the one who does the action (feeds).

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which pronoun can take the place of 'Maria and I' in this sentence? 'Maria and I sang a song at church.'
items.explain: 'Maria and I' is a subject that includes the speaker, so 'We' is correct.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word is a being (state-of-being) verb? 'The kittens were sleepy after their meal.'
items.explain: 'Were' is a form of 'be'; it links the kittens to 'sleepy'.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word is spelled correctly?
items.explain: The correct spelling is b-e-c-a-u-s-e. (Cursive capitals cannot be assessed in text, so spelling is measured instead.)

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Find an antonym in a passage
items.prompt: Read: 'At first, the path up the hill was smooth. Near the top, it became rough and full of rocks.' Which word in the passage is an antonym of 'smooth'?
items.explain: 'Rough' means the opposite of 'smooth'.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: We could not ___ the music because the room was so noisy.
items.explain: 'Hear' means to listen with your ears; 'here' is a place.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence uses capital letters correctly?
options: On thanksgiving day, we visited aunt Ruth.
On Thanksgiving day, We visited Aunt ruth.
On Thanksgiving Day, we visited Aunt Ruth.
on Thanksgiving Day, we visited aunt ruth.
items.explain: Holidays, titles used with names, names, and the first word of a sentence are capitalized.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: The robin built ___ nest in the maple tree.
items.explain: 'Its' shows ownership; 'it's' means 'it is'.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: What is the contraction for 'they will'?
items.explain: The apostrophe replaces 'wi' in 'will': they'll.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: An envelope has a name and address in the upper left corner: 'Ruth Allen, 12 Pine Street, Ocala, FL'. In the center it has: 'Mr. David Cole, 45 Lake Road, Tampa, FL'. Who will receive this letter?
items.explain: The address in the center belongs to the receiver; the upper left is the sender's return address.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word would come LAST in alphabetical order?
items.explain: Order is shadow, shell, shelter, shepherd; 'shep' comes after 'shel'.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Classify sentence types in a passage
items.prompt: Read: 'Mia helped her neighbor plant tomatoes. "Will they grow by summer?" she asked. Mr. Ortiz smiled. "Water them every day!"' Which sentence from the passage is interrogative?
options: Mia helped her neighbor plant tomatoes.
items.explain: An interrogative sentence asks a question and ends with a question mark.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word in this sentence is a plural common noun? 'On Friday, Pastor Lee read a story to the children at Grace Church.'
items.explain: 'Children' is plural and not a specific name; the others are proper nouns.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: What are the simple subject and the verb in this sentence? 'The busy bees in the garden make sweet honey.'
items.explain: 'Bees' is who does the action and 'make' is the verb; 'garden' is inside a prepositional phrase.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct pronoun: Mom gave the tickets to Isaac and ___.
items.explain: After the preposition 'to', use the object pronoun 'me'.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word is an adverb? 'The choir sang softly during the evening service.'
items.explain: 'Softly' tells how the choir sang, so it is an adverb.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence uses an apostrophe correctly?
options: My brother's bike has a flat tire.
items.explain: 'Brother's' correctly shows that the bike belongs to the brother.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
items.explain: The spoken words are in quotation marks with a comma inside, and the sentence ends with a period.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: We walked ___ the gate into the garden.
items.explain: 'Through' means from one side to the other; 'threw' is the past of throw.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: After the long hike, Dad wanted to ___ down on the couch.
items.explain: 'Lie' means to rest and takes no object; 'lay' needs an object.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct verb: By the time we arrived, the bell had already ___.
items.explain: After 'had', use the past participle of ring: rung.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Identify parts of a business letter
items.prompt: In a business letter, which part comes right before the writer's signature?
items.explain: The closing comes just before the signature; the heading, inside address and greeting come at the top.
